candidate_relations.reason: Although disseminated juvenile xanthogranuloma can show foamy histiocytes, Touton giant cells, and the same immunophenotype, the progressive widespread papulonodular eruption with mucosal involvement and deep dermal storiform spindle-cell fibrosis corresponds to progressive nodular histiocytosis, not juvenile xanthogranuloma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different subtype of non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis from progressive nodular histiocytosis.
